items.title: Origin Energy investigating 'potential' customer data breach
items.description: Origin Energy says it does not believe customer credit card or bank details have been affected by a suspected data breach at the company.

items.title: Minister says Australian IS-linked 'Doctor Jihad' can 'rot' in Iraqi jail
items.description: Perth paediatrician Tareq Kamleh went to Syria to join the Islamic State group in 2015 and has, until now, been presumed dead.

items.title: Australians don't understand how interest rates work, RBA finds
items.description: The Reserve Bank is concerned that too many Australians have little idea what the central bank is trying to achieve with interest rates, which it says could be making its job harder.

items.title: Meet the Australian multi-millionaire pardoned by Trump
items.description: Chris Wade was arrested by the Secret Service in Dallas in the early 2000s. It took him on a journey where he went from FBI hacker to Mar-a-Lago and eventually the White House before he came back to Australia to buy his favourite pub.

items.title: Actor to appeal after losing defamation case against Rebel Wilson
items.description: Hollywood actor Rebel Wilson successfully defends a defamation case brought against her by the star of her directorial debut.

items.title: Hanson labels domestic violence 'two-way street'
items.description: The One Nation leader said women should not 'put up with' domestic violence, as she highlighted the cost of living pressures on families.

items.title: Anxiety as Australia issues new travel advice for Middle East countries
items.description: As conflict between the United States and Iran escalates once again, the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade has issued a warning to "reconsider" travel to several more countries in the region.

items.title: Details of allegations against Alan Jones emerge after judge decision
items.description: Details of allegations against veteran broadcaster Alan Jones can be revealed, after a non-publication order was lifted by a judge.

items.title: Former Socceroos captain Paul Wade reveals probable CTE diagnosis
items.description: Paul Wade says he wants to share his experience to raise awareness about concussion, repeated head impacts and brain health across all levels of football.

items.title: Grass 'skeletons' hint at 25,000-year-old Indigenous fire ritual in cave
items.description: Evidence of ancient burnt grasses unearthed in a Victorian cave suggest the old ancestors of the GunaiKurnai people used the cave for fire rituals during the Ice Age.

items.title: 'Why would I do that?': Boy in court charged with murdering mother, stabbing sister
items.description: A 16-year-old boy is charged with murdering his mother and attempting to kill his sister in Perth's south-east, as police say the girl is being treated in hospital for "very serious" stab wounds.

items.title: Rural suburb flagged as home for proposed $40b 'hyperscale' data centre
items.description: A proposed massive new data centre would require more than six times the total demand of the Darwin and Katherine electricity grids to operate and be powered by gas piped direct from the Northern Territory's Beetaloo Basin.

items.title: Private 'space port' to test guided weapons in Queensland outback
items.description: Black Sky Aerospace will construct a new airstrip and explosives storage to support defence and aerospace testing within the state.

items.title: The risks and claims behind these popular wellness treatments
items.description: Wellness and anti-aging clinics are popping up across Australia. But do their treatments work and are they safe?

items.title: As The Odyssey smashes box office records, one name is drawing people in
items.description: The Odyssey's director Sir Christopher Nolan has a stellar catalogue. Interstellar, even. But as his new film smashes box office records, is it safe to crown him the new king of Hollywood?

items.title: New Ozploitation horror is like Puberty Blues from hell
items.description: After spending years in special effects and make-up, filmmaker Mia'Kate Russell's ocker nightmare Penny Lane Is Dead has made it to the silver screen.

items.title: 'I just laid in his cot and cried': Mothers on child loss
items.description: Women who have lost children talk about continuing in the wake of such grief, and how people stepped up, or stepped away.

items.title: Lewis breaks Australian 100m record, beats five-time Olympic champ
items.description: Torrie Lewis shows she is hitting her straps ahead of the Commonwealth Games by beating her own record mark during a meet in Slovakia.

items.title: NT to become last jurisdiction to legalise voluntary assisted dying
items.description: The Northern Territory is set to make voluntary assisted dying legal in August. The ABC understands all 17 Country Liberal Party government members will vote in favour of the Rights of the Terminally Ill Act.

items.title: Judge says there's a 'real risk' to safety of Bondi Beach attack witnesses
items.description: Twenty witnesses in the Bondi Beach terror attack case have been granted anonymity, with a judge saying there is a "real risk" to their safety.

items.title: Atlassian toasts $1b hybrid tower milestone after axing 500 jobs for AI
items.description: When construction finishes next year, the Sydney building will be the tallest hybrid structure in the world by 100 metres.

items.title: Network 10 moves 10 News+ from weekdays
items.description: Network 10 says its 10 News+ news and current affairs program is moving from its nightly weekday slot and will be aired on Sunday nights only.

items.title: 'These things didn't happen': Senior Catholic cleric denies sex abuse
items.description: The lawyer for a former Catholic bishop who allegedly sexually abused three young men tells his trial the incidents did not happen, and warns the jury not to be affected by possible prejudice against the church.

items.title: Unlawful excavation of river cliff disturbs Aboriginal ancestral remains
items.description: A cliff site in South Australia's Riverland, home to Aboriginal ancestral remains, has been excavated without authorisation.

items.title: Doctor reveals injuries of woman allegedly sexually assaulted by Yung Filly
items.description: Graphic photographs of injuries allegedly inflicted by an internationally renowned YouTube star on an infatuated fan in his hotel room after a concert are shown to a jury at his sexual assault trial in a Perth court.
